title: Sputnik Speaker
description: Speaker developed as a RenderWeekly challenge, out of curiosities about additive manufacturing through Grasshopper in Rhino, and Blender for organic forms.
research_intro: Wireless speakers are a fast-growing category where form is a selling point, which is what made it a good test bed for additive manufacturing.

brief.label: Brief
brief.text: A RenderWeekly challenge, used to explore additive manufacturing with Grasshopper in Rhino and organic modeling in Blender.

brief.label: Design response
brief.text: A spherical driver pod carried on a lattice stand, a form that only additive manufacturing could produce in one piece.

brief.label: Competition
brief.text: Speakers from Bose, Marshall and Sony, where styling is a large part of the purchase.
